name: Roasted Redskin Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Put potatoes and bay leaves in a large Dutch oven. Put enough water to cover and bring to a rolling boil. Cook for 15 minutes or until tender.
Drain and shock. Drain again and discard bay leaves. Pat dry with paper towels.
Whisk together oil and remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and toss to coat.
Bake in a 425°F oven for 10 minutes or until lightly to deeply brown. Serve.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
